name: Bahurim

related_people.name: Ahimaaz
related_people.role: hid in a well in this town from Absalom's pursuers while carrying word to David

related_people.name: Palti
related_people.role: followed his wife Michal weeping as far as this town when David reclaimed her

related_people.name: Shimei
related_people.role: cursed and threw stones at David as he passed through here in flight

description: A Benjaminite town where Shimei cursed and threw stones at David as he fled Absalom's rebellion (2 Samuel 16:5-13), and where a woman hid David's spies Ahimaaz and Jonathan in a well to save them from Absalom's search party (2 Samuel 17:18-20).
family_friendly_summary: Bahurim was a town David passed through when he was fleeing from his son Absalom. A man named Shimei shouted insults and threw stones at him there. In the same town, two of David's messengers once hid from Absalom's search party by climbing down into a well.
